camel_example: aliyun ice SubmitAIAgentVideoAuditTask --region cn-hangzhou --Input '{"Type":"OSS","Media":"http://my-bucket.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/object-id.mp4"}' --CapturePolicies '[{"FrameCount":2,"StartTime":0,"Duration":10,"Prompt":"请分析视频中的场景"}]' --AIAgentId 00000003b3d94abda22000000 --version 2020-11-09 --method POST --force
description_en: Submits a video moderation task that uses an AI agent to review video content. This operation supports Object Storage Service (OSS) input, allows you to customize video frame capture policies and moderation rules, and returns moderation results through asynchronous callbacks
description_zh: 该接口是一个视频送审服务,通过AI智能体对视频内容进行审核,支持OSS输入,允许用户自定义视频截帧策略和审核规则,并通过异步回调的方式返回审核结果
kebab_example: aliyun ice submit-ai-agent-video-audit-task --ai-agent-id 00000003b3d94abda22000000 --input Type=OSS Media=http://my-bucket.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/object-id.mp4 --capture-policies FrameCount=2 StartTime=0 Duration=10 Prompt=请分析视频中的场景 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitAIAgentVideoAuditTask

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AI agent
parameters.name: ai_agent_id

fields.help_zh:
输入文件信息，支持OSS地址。
形如

http(s)://{BucketName}.{Endpoint}/{ObjectName}

当前只支持和服务同地域的OSS，比如上海区域的接口服务只支持上海的OSS
fields.name: media

fields.help_en:
The input type. Valid values:

OSS: the URL of an OSS file
fields.help_zh:
输入类型，取值：

OSS：OSS文件地址
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The authentication token for the callback
fields.name: token

fields.help_en: The URL where you want to receive callback notifications
fields.help_zh: 用户希望接收回调通知的URL
fields.name: url

parameters.help_en: The moderation interval, in milliseconds. Valid values: 0 to 5000. Default value: 3000. If you set this parameter to 0, all captured frame data specified in CapturePolicies is sent to the large model in the corresponding agent at a time. If you set this parameter to a non-zero value, such as 3000, all captured frame data is sent to the large model in sequence at an interval of 3,000 milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 送审节奏（毫秒）：范围为0-5000ms，默认值为3000ms。 当入参为0时，则将CapturePolicies中的所有截帧后的数据一次性请求对应Agent中的大模型。 如果值为非0，例如3000ms，则代表着将所有截帧后的数据按3000ms为间隔有序请求大模型
parameters.name: audit_interval

fields.help_en: The duration of a single frame capture, in seconds
fields.name: duration

fields.help_en: The number of frames to capture
fields.name: frame_count

fields.example: Please analyze the scene in the video
fields.help_en: The text parameter used when you call the multimodal large model
fields.help_zh: 请求多模态大模型时的文本参数
fields.name: prompt

fields.help_en: The time when frame capture is triggered, in seconds
fields.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The array of moderation policies. Each policy generates a model result
parameters.help_zh: 送审策略数组。每个策略会得到一个模型结果
parameters.name: capture_policies
